C gov010.cs-approved OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; The value is approved (new values proposed with a reason and approved first). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.cs-conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A conflict with SPECIFICATION.md stops the workflow until the user decides which source to correct. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.cs-belongs OL GOV-011,GOV-008 MUST ;; The value belongs in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md per CLAUDE.md (Product sources). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-no-framework-defaults EX GOV-011,GOV-008 MUST_NOT ;; Do not record a framework default the project has not intentionally overridden. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov010.cs-record OL GOV-010,GOV-008 MUST ;; Record the setting with a stable descriptive name, value and purpose. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-single-source EX GOV-021 PREFER ;; Avoid duplicating the same literal across layers when a single source in code or configuration is appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov021.cs-search-update OL GOV-021 MUST ;; Search for the old value, setting name, validators/DTO constraints, Domain/Application checks, persistence mapping, frontend validation/hints, tests/test data, docs/examples and mirrored configuration; distinguish coincidences; update every affected surface and only affected behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst009.cs-persistence OL PST-009 MUST ;; Schema-relevant changes: update the mapping, create the appropriate migration per the workflow, verify Development seeding, update provider-sensitive tests; do not casually alter existing migrations; run persistence-change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe010.cs-backend-authoritative OL FE-010 MUST ;; When both sides expose the same constraint backend validation stays authoritative; frontend validation and messages stay synchronized for UX and are never relied on for security or integrity. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.cs-verify OL GOV-021,WF-003 MUST ;; Before completion search for stale references, build affected projects, run relevant tests, verify persistence changes, recheck SPECIFICATION.md, then run verify; changing one literal alone does not establish synchronization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-report EX WF-009 MUST ;; Report the setting, old → new value, every updated surface, migration created and the verify result. ;; = ;; none ;; Workflow output contract not in the oracle.

C x.dc-discover EX GOV-013,WF-001 MUST ;; Inspect the repository before writing a pipeline or container file; do not assume a database provider, cache, container or frontend tooling; add stages for the actual project, not generic boilerplate. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf017.dc-ci-truthful OL WF-017,WF-015 MUST ;; CI definitions live in source control, reproduce supported build/test commands and never hide failures (no suppressed tests, ignored exit codes or continue-on-error for required checks). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.dc-scripts-npm-ci OL WF-018 MUST ;; Frontend CI uses scripts that exist in package.json and npm ci when a maintained lockfile supports it; never invent scripts or reflexively replace lockfile installs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.dc-gates-adopted OL WF-007 MUST ;; Enforced formatting/analyzer gates only when the project adopted them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dc-no-auto-upgrades EX DEP-003 MUST_NOT ;; No automatic package upgrades unless the project adopted automated updates. ;; = ;; Adopted automation. ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep018.dc-artifacts-when-deployed OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Build images and deployable artifacts only when the project deploys them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.dc-image-surfaces OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Images, build arguments and committed Compose files are source-controlled surfaces subject to the secrets rule. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.dc-prod-migrations OL WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Production migrations must not run automatically from normal startup by default; they are an explicit deployment step at a controlled point with approved credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst004.dc-no-prod-seeding OL PST-004,WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Development seeding never runs in Production. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.dc-secrets OL SEC-002,SEC-001 MUST ;; Pipeline secrets come from the CI platform's secret/identity mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dc-env-protection EX - DEFAULT ;; A green CI build does not imply every branch deploys; use environment protection or approval where the platform supports it. ;; delivery ;; Platform support. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dc-verify EX WF-003,WF-006 MUST ;; Before completion verify the pipeline restores from a clean environment, builds backend and frontend, runs configured tests, does not depend on developer-machine state, exposes no secrets and produces expected artifacts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf009.dc-report-status OL WF-009 MUST ;; Report each pipeline verification item as PASS / NOT RUN / NOT APPLICABLE. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.di-boundaries EX ARC-021,ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Use abstractions at architectural boundaries (Application services, repositories, external adapters); concrete registration is fine for implementation-only helpers. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.di-explicit-prefer EX GOV-012 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit registration in small and medium applications; scanning, keyed services, factories or decorators only for actual composition problems. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc022.di-captive OL ARC-022,ARC-007 MUST_NOT ;; Never register an Application service depending on scoped repositories as a singleton; a singleton/hosted service needing scoped work creates a scope per operation and resolves a scoped orchestration service, not Infrastructure internals. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-keyed-when EX GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keyed services for several implementations selected by a known key, not when a single registration or simple factory is clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.di-scrutor-not-for-single EX DEP-001,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add Scrutor for a single decoration when normal composition is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.di-scanning-when EX GOV-012,ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Use assembly scanning only when registration volume creates genuine boilerplate, scanning the assembly that owns the services. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C gov002.dw-read-spec OL GOV-002,GOV-009 MUST ;; Before planning or implementing a new application or substantial feature read SPECIFICATION.md (and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md for tunable values); handle gaps and conflicts per CLAUDE.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.dw-inspect OL WF-001 MUST ;; Before any non-trivial change inspect the relevant code, read the applicable standards for the touched areas and load relevant knowledge skills (facets named in the register). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.dw-challenge OL GOV-018 MUST ;; Apply the challenge obligation to a questionable request before implementing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.dw-classify OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify each consequential choice per decision control; Reserved choices go to architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.dw-scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep the change inside the requested scope. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.dw-regression OL TST-009 DEFAULT ;; For a meaningful bug with plausible recurrence add a regression test that fails before and passes after the fix unless equivalent coverage exists. ;; = ;; Equivalent coverage exists. ;;
C run012.dw-perf OL RUN-012 MUST ;; Performance-motivated change: identify the bottleneck, preserve behaviour, simplest effective optimization, maintain tests, benchmark/profile non-obvious or complex optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api022.dw-deprecation OL API-022 MUST ;; Deprecating an externally consumed version: mark it in versioning metadata, document the replacement, communicate a realistic migration period and removal timeline, keep it working for the promised support period; never remove it without considering the support contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov007.dw-durable-source OL GOV-007 MUST ;; When a new behavioural rule is approved update the durable source of truth in the same change, including SPECIFICATION.md when appropriate; tunable values via custom-settings, decisions via architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf002.dw-code-review OL WF-002 MUST ;; For substantial feature work or a new application run code-review (or the code-reviewer agent) before final verification and fix confirmed findings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.dw-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Before declaring implementation complete run verify at the depth scope and risk require. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.dw-report-unresolved OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Report every unresolved Decision Request. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dw-report EX WF-009 MUST ;; Summarize what changed and why, the verify report and approvals obtained. ;; = ;; none ;; Workflow output contract not in the oracle.

C dep018.dk-optional OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Containers are optional infrastructure (decision register). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep019.dk-no-build-tooling OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Keep build tooling out of production images. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-principles EX DEP-018,ARC-002 DEFAULT ;; Keep configuration external, images reproducible and Docker concerns out of Domain/Application code. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-copy-explicit EX DEP-023 MUST ;; Copy only repository-level build files that exist and restore needs; copy project files explicitly (no flattening wildcards) and update the section when the solution changes; never trade a correct restore graph for layer caching. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep019.dk-runtime-nonroot OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; ASP.NET runtime image for ASP.NET Core and an appropriate runtime image for workers; the built-in non-root app user when it fits, with proper ownership/permissions for written directories. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-runtime-config EX SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Pass environment-specific configuration at runtime (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, ConnectionStrings__Default, Authentication__Authority). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec001.dk-secret-surfaces OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST ;; Supply secrets through platform/container secret mechanisms; check the Dockerfile, committed Compose files, build arguments and copied appsettings for credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-compose-actual-infra EX GOV-013,DEP-018 MUST ;; Use Compose for local infrastructure only when beneficial and add only services the project uses. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec001.dk-local-passwords OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST ;; Keep local passwords in an ignored .env or similar mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-probes EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Expose liveness/readiness through ASP.NET Core health checks and prefer orchestrator-native HTTP probes; for in-container health commands verify the executable exists or add an explicit probe, weighing extra packages in production images. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-static-frontend EX DEP-018 DEFAULT ;; Build static frontend assets in a Node stage and serve them with the selected hosting strategy (a web server image is not mandatory); keep API base URLs and environment configuration compatible. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-dockerignore EX - MUST ;; Exclude .git, .vs, bin, obj, node_modules, TestResults and coverage, but not tests the image build runs or files restore/build needs. ;; delivery ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-image-variants EX RUN-008,GOV-013 DEFAULT ;; Start with standard images; Alpine, chiseled, trimming or Native AOT only when compatibility and deployment requirements justify them, verifying globalization, native dependencies, reflection and diagnostics. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dk-verify EX WF-006,SEC-001 MUST ;; Build the image and verify startup, port/configuration, non-root behaviour, health-probe integration and absence of accidental secrets/files; run meaningful tests outside or in the pipeline. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

61 EX [x.dt-unit-candidates]
63 OL [tst003.dt-app-service-tests]

69-99 NN ;; Integration test example.

111-114 NN ;; FakeTimeProvider example.

124 NN ;; Heading.
126 OL [tst012.dt-naming]

132 NN ;; Heading.
134 MX [x.dt-smoke-definition,tst011.dt-coverage,x.dt-snapshots] ;; Coverage as diagnostic restates TST-011; the smoke-test definition and snapshot guidance are added.
136 NN ;; Heading.
138 MX [tst003.dt-no-impl-repeat,x.dt-no-assertion-free,tst004.dt-no-delays,tst007.dt-testcontainers-need] ;; Anti-patterns restating TST-003/TST-004/TST-007; assertion-free tests have no owner clause and are registered.
140 NN ;; Heading.
142-143 NN ;; Table header.
144-152 DU [tst005.explicit-cases,tst006.waf,tst007.provider-fidelity,run004.timeprovider,tst009.dt-regression,tst010.dt-probes,x.dt-smoke-definition] ;; Decision guide restating the rules and guidance above.

C x.dt-proportional-infra EX GOV-012,TST-011 DEFAULT ;; Do not build test infrastructure without a concrete testing need; a small project does not need an enterprise harness. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dt-aaa-constraint EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Arrange/Act/Assert is a useful default (comments optional when obvious); use the NUnit constraint model (Assert.That). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst005.dt-testcase-rows OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; Explicit cases are [TestCase] rows with the expected value as an argument rather than TestCaseSource generators or computed expectations; a longer explicit table beats a shorter algorithmic test. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-one-scenario EX TST-003 PREFER ;; Prefer one observable scenario per test; multi-step tests when the sequence itself is the scenario. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dt-unit-candidates EX TST-002,TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Unit-test candidates: domain behaviour owned by Domain, calculations, state transitions, validation, Application orchestration with simple fakes; do not mock every collaborator mechanically nor forbid mocking project-owned abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst003.dt-app-service-tests OL TST-003,TST-002,TST-006 DEFAULT ;; Application Service tests replace abstractions with controlled doubles and assert results and meaningful side effects; call-count assertions only when the interaction is the contract; prefer integration tests when persistence semantics, transactions, DI, serialization or HTTP matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.dt-testing-env OL TST-004 MUST ;; Configure the Testing environment with isolated test resources so integration tests can never reach a Development or Production database. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.dt-known-state OL TST-008,TST-004 MUST ;; Start from a known state (recreate/reset the isolated database, fitting transactions, only needed data, unique identifiers); never modify production data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-state-tradeoff EX TST-007 MUST ;; Choose the test-database strategy by what the test must prove (provider fidelity vs application/API integration) and be explicit about the trade-off. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run004.dt-faketime OL RUN-004,TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Inject TimeProvider and control it with FakeTimeProvider in tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.dt-no-external OL TST-004 MUST_NOT ;; Never call uncontrolled external services from normal test runs; use fakes, stub handlers or local fake servers; a sandbox only when the test explicitly targets that integration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-slow-separate EX TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Keep slow or unreliable external-system tests out of ordinary fast runs. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.dt-test-data EX TST-008,GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keep test data explicit and minimal; builders/fixtures only when repeated setup becomes hard to read; no generic test-data framework for a few objects. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst012.dt-naming OL TST-012 DEFAULT ;; MethodOrScenario_StateOrCondition_ExpectedBehavior naming unless an established project convention exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst009.dt-regression OL TST-009 DEFINITION ;; A regression test reproduces the failure before the fix and passes after; skip it when recurrence is unrealistic or coverage exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.dt-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Convert temporary behavioural checks (ad-hoc requests, scripts, test methods, manual DB checks) into maintained tests (e.g. WebApplicationFactory tests); verify that existing coverage really exercises the behaviour; review probes before promoting them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-smoke-definition EX WF-006 DEFINITION ;; A smoke test is a small set of fast checks that a built or deployed application is basically operational, not every integration test. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst011.dt-coverage OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Coverage is diagnostic, not a target; prioritize meaningful behaviour, edge cases and risky integrations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-snapshots EX TST-003,DEP-001 DEFAULT ;; Snapshot testing for large stable outputs only; no snapshot library by default; explicit assertions for small or important contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst003.dt-no-impl-repeat OL TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertions that merely repeat the implementation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-no-assertion-free EX TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertion-free tests unless the behaviour is 'does not throw'. ;; = ;; none ;; No owner clause for this item.
C tst004.dt-no-delays OL TST-004 AVOID ;; Avoid arbitrary delays such as Task.Delay to make timing-sensitive tests pass. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.dt-testcontainers-need OL TST-007 AVOID ;; Avoid Testcontainers when no provider fidelity is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
